config._note: NoDiary 的美术生成配置。只用来做背景/氛围插画——小羊本体和配饰是 SwiftUI Canvas 矢量 + SVG，不要让扩散模型碰它们(扩散模型做不到同一角色换 11 种颜色的一致性,而且 20px 的日历格子里光栅会糊)。所有资产都是 texture 满幅,因此一律 no_anchor,风格词写进各自 prompt。
config.style_anchor: soft cozy storybook landscape, gouache painting with visible gentle brush texture, broad flat colour fields, muted pastel palette of sage green and pale sky blue, soft diffuse daylight, calm and almost empty, no animals, no people, no buildings, no text, not photorealistic, not busy
config.negative: sheep, animals, people, buildings, houses, fences, roads, text, watermark, signature, frame, border, harsh shadows, high contrast, dark, saturated neon, busy detail, clutter, photo, 3d render, low quality, blurry
